subs.math: USD 10 + USD 0.0125 × 1,000 active readers = USD 22.50. Assumes all readers are billable and there is no other traffic.
USD 10 + USD 0.0125 × 5,000 active readers = USD 72.50. Assumes all readers are billable and there is no other traffic.
USD 10 + USD 0.0125 × 10,000 active readers = USD 135. Assumes all readers are billable and there is no other traffic.
The Pro rate formula gives USD 549 a month, but the high-volume plan still needs to be confirmed.
